tools.name: get_full_hierarchy
tools.description: Returns the ordered layout chain and page component subtree for a Next.js App Router route.

route.description: Next.js App Router route path (e.g., /, /dashboard, /posts/[slug], /[...rest]). Must start with /. No trailing slash except for root.

format.description: Output format: markdown (default, LLM-friendly tree) or json (structured object for programmatic use).

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the Next.js project root. Defaults to UI_TO_HIERARCH_ROOT env var, then process.cwd().

tools.name: focus_on
tools.description: Returns the component subtree rooted at a named JSX component, optionally including ancestors.

component.description: JSX component name in PascalCase (e.g., Card, DashboardLayout). Lowercase tags and kebab-case are rejected.

scope.description: Traversal scope: 'up' (ancestors only), 'full' (ancestors + subtree, default), 'down' (subtree only).

format.description: Output format: markdown (default, LLM-friendly tree) or json (structured object for programmatic use).

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the Next.js project root. Defaults to UI_TO_HIERARCH_ROOT env var, then process.cwd().

tools.name: find_by_text
tools.description: Finds component nodes whose rendered text content matches the given query string. Returns matching nodes with file:line location.

query.description: Text string to search for in rendered component output (e.g., Submit, Cancel, Hello World).

format.description: Output format: markdown (default, LLM-friendly tree) or json (structured object for programmatic use).

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the Next.js project root. Defaults to UI_TO_HIERARCH_ROOT env var, then process.cwd().

tools.name: find_by_style
tools.description: Finds component nodes that use a given CSS class name or style prop. Returns matching nodes with file:line location.

class_or_prop.description: CSS class name or style prop to search for (e.g., flex, bg-blue-500, color, marginTop).

format.description: Output format: markdown (default, LLM-friendly tree) or json (structured object for programmatic use).

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the Next.js project root. Defaults to UI_TO_HIERARCH_ROOT env var, then process.cwd().
